item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 16/Mar/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will affect the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. The weather will improve gradually over the region, and it will be cool in the morning and at night. With the monsoon moderating in the middle and latter parts of this week, temperatures will rise over Guangdong. The weather will be persistently fine and dry. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.

Date/Month: 17/03 (Monday)
Wind: North to northeast force 4 to 5.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Rather cool in the morning. Dry with sunny intervals during the day.
Temp range: 14 - 20 C
R.H. range: 40 - 65 per Cent
PSR: Low
